study.programTiming: producer at tick 0, grazer at tick 1, decomposer at tick 2; no later intervention.

checks: Default 500-tick configuration is unchanged; explicit durations reserve 2 transfers per organism per tick.
1536 * 32 * 2 = 98304 evidence attempts fits the unchanged 100000-attempt ledger cap.
A non-reproducing population dies at its full 512-tick lifespan and returns all biomass.
A run restored at tick 768 follows the same inputs and commitments to tick 1536.
Changed commitments after tick 500 are rejected at the changed frame.
Births, deaths, generation, population and matter remain within their finite budgets.
Legacy default replay preserves initial/final commitments and continues with the original configuration.
Dashboard displays persisted limits; invalid durations cannot create a partial tank.
Rewriting an outer owner field cannot transfer a foreign world between players.
A failed save after tick 511 preserves exact prior bytes and allows an exact 20-tick retry.
An envelope with three maximal program updates in each of 1536 frames fits the unchanged 4 MiB budget.
Boundary scan and git diff whitespace checks passed.
limits: The 24 study cases are pure simulations on two synthetic world IDs, not live Paper/Folia or human trials.
The previous 500-tick candidate loses a species after the observation horizon; long-term balance remains unproven.
New optional-duration commands have no new live-server acceptance in this batch.
The maximal serialized envelope test uses deliberately invalid commitments for size measurement and confirms playback rejects them.
The replay schema and per-step algorithm are unchanged; older plugin versions reject new durations above 500.
Maven tests ran without forks and under strict memory limits; no production capacity claim.
Signer checks use ephemeral keys; official signing, real integrations and other P0-P11 acceptance remain open.
